The Island is never a fortunate sign. Whereever it makes its appearance, it reduces the promise of the Line or Mount on which it may be found.
On the Line of Life it shows delicacy or illness at that particular date where it appears (1, Plate XXII.).
Lower down on the Line of Health on the Mount of the Moon, it indicates a grave tendency towards kidney and bladder troubles (7, Plate XXII.).
The Spot is a sign of temporary arrest of the qualities of any Line on which it may be found.

The Grille (10, Plate XXII.) is very often seen on the Mounts of the Hand. It denotes difficulties and obstacles in connection with whatever the Mount represents, and a lack of success in whatever quality or talent the Mount symbolises.

On the Mount of Saturn it is the one unfavourable sign of this particular mark, and on this Mount it gives distinction, but one to be dreaded. Such a person will be the plaything of destiny, a man cast for some terrible part in the tragedy of life. Such a man's life will end in some terrible disaster, but one which will cause his name to be on everyone's lips. A king perhaps, but one crowned by doom.

This sign is the direct opposite to the preceding sign, and has only one favourable position, viz., on the Mount of Jupiter where it indicates some extraordinary fortunate affection which will come into the life. On all the other Mounts it is evil.
On the Mount of the Moon it denotes a fatal influence to the imagination. Such a man will deceive himself. When low down on this Mount it foreshadows death by drowning.
On the Mount of Venus it indicates some fatal influence of the affections.
When on the Line of Life it means preservation from death. (13, Plate XXII.)
The lines on the palm should be clearly marked, a good pink or reddish colour, and they should be free from breaks, crosses, holes or irregularities of all kinds.
When very pale in colour they show lack of force and loss of energy, and often poor health.

Forked lines are generally good and increase the quality of the special indication. When at the end of the Line of Head, the fork gives more of what is called a dual mentality and less power of concentration on any one
Tasselled Lines (Plate XXIV.) are not good signs. They weaken any indication the line itself denotes, and at the end of a Life Line they foreshadow loss of all nervous energy.

Broken Lines (Plate XXIV.) destroy the meaning of the line at the particular place where the break appears, but if one line ends above the other, the break is not so bad and the quality of the line will be continued.
Islands (Plate XXIV.) are always evil and denote weakness or failure of the Line or Mount on which they may be found.

Ascending Lines (Plate XXIV.) are good from any line from which they spring. From the Line of Life they denote increased energy wherever they make their appearance. If they run up to any particular Mount or part of the hand, they show that the increased effort or energy will be in that particular direction.
When the entire hand is covered with a network of small lines, it denotes a highly nervous disposition and usually great mental worry and lack of decision.

When something is marked on the left hand and not on the right, the tendency will be in the nature, but unless it is also marked on the right hand it will never bear fruit or come to any result. When the two hands are exactly alike, it denotes that the subject has not developed in any way from what heredity or Nature gave to him.

It must be remembered that we use the left side of the brain more than we do the right, and the nerves cross and go to the right hand. Consequently, it is this hand which denotes the developed or active brain, the left only giving the natural tendencies or inclinations.

To be scientific and accurate the student of this subject must always keep this rule before his mind and not be led away in his judgment by some marvellously good line that the subject may proudly call his attention to in the left hand, for such a mark will have no actual result unless it is also found on the right hand.

The Great Triangle is formed by the lines of Head, Life, and Health (Plate XXV.). The larger this triangle is, the better will be the health, for the reason that the Line of Health will be further removed from the Life Line. The views of life will also be broader and the field of action as it were less limited.

This division into periods of seven is the most natural one of all, as the entire nature changes every seven years. Long experience has proved that, by dividing the hand in the manner shown in the accompanying illustration, the best possible results as regards dates are obtained.

We now leave the domain of what must be considered Palmistry, the study of the Lines of the Palmor Cheiromancy, as it was called by the Greeks from the word xeip, the hand, and proceed to consider the meanings that can be derived from the shapes of the hands, fingers, etc., which is called Cheirognomy.

It is even a remarkable thing that though work and exercise may enlarge and broaden the hand, yet the type to which it belongs is never destroyed, but can be easily detected by anyone who has made a study of such matters.

The Square type (Plate I., Part II.,) is so designated on account of the palm being like a square in shape, or at least nearly so. Such a hand in fact looks square. It is rather straight or even at the wrist, at the base of the fingers, and also at the sides. The fingers themselves also have a square-cut appearance. The thumb is, however, nearly always long, well-shaped, and set high on the palm, and stands well out from the palm.

hand. People who possess this type are essentially practical, logical, and rather materialistic. They belong to the earth and the things of the earth. They have little imagination or idealism, they are solid, serious workers, methodical and painstaking in all they do. They believe in things only by proof and by their reason. They are often religious and even superstitious, but more from habit than from anything else.

They are not built on the hard set square lines of the former type. These persons have enormous imagination, their creative faculties largely developed. They are inventive, unconventional, emotional, demonstrative, and in fact the complete opposite in character to the class who possesses the square type of hand.
The Spatulate type has also the palm irregular in shape. It may be wider at the base of the fingers than at the wrist, or it may be found vice versa.

The Philosophic Hand is long, bony, and angular with knotty joints, and is as a general rule fairly thin. People with this type of hand are always studious. They are great readers and usually have a strong tendency towards literature. They love sedentary work, and have a somewhat lonely, ascetic disposition. Perhaps on account of this quality they are very often found in church-life, or largely associated with religious movements. The monks

of old, I mean those who compiled those wonderful manuscripts on doctrine, science, art, alchemy, and occult matters, all had this class of hand. In our modern times this type may be easily recognised, and the qualities it expresses remain the same even in the age of money- getting and machinery.

It is, however, more usual nowadays to find a slight modification of the true philosophic hand in that of the hand with the palm square and with the fingers only belonging to the philosophic type. In such cases the practical nature is a basis or foundation on which the studious mind builds its theories, its religion, its literary achievements, or its scientific researches.

As arule the Line of Head on such hands is rather sloping, but it may also be found almost straight, and when it is, a more level-headed disposition will make more practical use of the studious nature. But speaking generally, people with this type of hand rarely accumulate as much wealth as those possessing the Square Hand.

The Conic, also called the Artistic, Hand (Plate II., Part IL.), is always graceful looking, with the fingers tapering and pointed. It has, not only on account of its appearance but also because of the qualities it represents, been called the Artistic Hand.

Its possessor may not always paint pictures or design beautiful things, but he will have the emotional, artistic temperament, which loves beautiful surroundings, and is most sensitive to colour, music, and all the fine arts. It largely depends on the kind of Head Line and the will power shown by it, to determine whether its owner will develop the natural artistic temperament that he or she possesses.
The harder and firmer this type of hand is, the more likely it is to find that its possessor will really make something out of his artistic temperament.

It is very often found having all the fingers different from one another, as for example one pointed, one square, or spatulate, and so on. Or sometimes the palm may be of one type, say spatulate, with all the fingers mixed.
It is only when the Line of Head is found on such hands clear and straight that there is a likelihood of these persons developing some one talent out of the versatility that this type gives.

In the judgment of character by the formation of the Hand, the Thumb is of about the same importance as the nose is to the face. It must be understood to represent the natural Will Power, whereas the Line of Head represents the Mental Will.

In my larger works on this subject I have gone into very deeply the medical reasons why character should be expressed by the Thumb and the extraordinary réle it has played in civilisation, and also in the various religions of the world.
The Thumb proper represents the three great worlds of ideas, viz., Love, Logic, and Will (Plate V1., Part II.).

This denotes a nature pliable and adaptable to others, very broad-minded, rather unconventional, and not obstinate in its views of life. These characteristics will be increased if the Head Line be found sloping and bending downwards. If, however, the Line of Head be found lying straight across the palm, they are more conventional. The supple-jointed thumb also denotes generosity of mind both as regards thought and money. In all ways these people are more extravagant than people who have the straight firm-jointed thumb. In other words they give more even in what they think as well as in what they do.
miser has always a thumb cramped towards the hand, and the nail phalange as a rule slightly turned in, as if the mind wanted to grab hold or retain.

If a favour should be asked of the man with the supple- jointed Thumb, one should remember that he is more inclined to give in on the impulse of the moment, and if one does not press one's point home at once, he is likely first to promise, and later, on reflection, change his mind.

The man with the stiff-jointed Thumb (Fig. 3, Plate III.) on the contrary, is more likely to refuse at first and on reflection to agree to the proposition; but it he does make up his mind, he will stick to his judgment or opinion, and the more he is opposed the more determined he will be to hold to his view.
The firm-jointed thumb is then the outward sign of a more resisting nature, and the longer the first or nail phalange is, the stronger and more powerful the Will force.

These people seldom make friends so easily or rapidly as those belonging to the other type. On a railway journey they rarely begin a conversation with a fellow traveller, and if they have to do so it will generally be in the form of an argument that the window must be left open or shut, as the case may be. Heaven help the other poor traveller if he should also happen to have a stiff thumb, and oppose his ideas to those of the first.

The supple-jointed class, on the contrary, enter readily into conversation with strangers, and they often make their greatest friends while travelling. They are affable, charming companions, and give in readily to the wishes of others. In fact, this quality inclines to a weakness that should be guarded against. Among all those men and women who take the easiest way a large majority will be found to have very supple-jointed thumbs. This, however, will be greatly qualified by the position and appearance of the Line of Head, the indicator of the developed mental will.

The third phalange of the Thumb, which is placed under the designation of Love (Plate VI., Part II.), when found long, denotes more control over the quality of Love or Sensuality; when short and thick-set, the passion or sensual nature is more brutal and animal.

The space at my disposal in this work will not allow me to go deeper into all the shades of character that can be made out by a study of the Thumb alone, but I think I have said enough to show my readers the great truth in D'Arpentigny's words that the Thumb individualises the man.
The Finger of Jupiter, when long, gives love of power and command over others. When short it denotes dislike of responsibility and lack of ambition.
The Finger of Saturn when long gives prudence, love of solitude and a reserved, studious disposition. When short it denotes frivolity and general lack of seriousness in all things.

The Finger of Mercury when long gives mental power, grasp of languages, and power of expression, especially in speech. When short it denotes difficulty in speaking, and in the expression of thoughts. When crooked, with an irregular Head Line, it is an evil sign of the Mentality.

The fingers should be long in proportion to the palm; they then denote greater intellectuality and mental power. When short and stubby looking, the subject is inclined to animalism and gross materialism.
When the fingers lean towards one another, they take after the qualities expressed by the finger towards which they lean.
A wide space between the thumb and first finger denotes independence of will and fearlessness.

The same type of Nail, but shorter in appearance, indicates that the delicacy lies higher up towards the throat, and denotes tendencies for laryngitis, inflammation of the throat, and all bronchial troubles.

Nails short in appearance denote a tendency towards weak action of the heart, more especially so when the moons are very small or barely noticeable. When the Nails appear very flat and sunk into the flesh at the base they denote nerve diseases. When they are ribbed across the Nail from side to side, the danger is still more apparent.

When a deep furrow is found across the Nail, it is a sign in any hand that an unusual call has recently been made on the nervous system by illness. If the following rule be studied, the date of this illness or strain can be very clearly indicated.

As it takes about nine months for a nail to grow out from the base to the outer edge, the nail can easily be divided into sections. When the furrow or very deep rib is seen close to the edge, the illness took place about nine months ago; when the furrow is seen about the centre, the date was about from four to five months, and when at the base, about one month previously.
when the Nail is seen covered with small white flecks, the whole nervous system is in a low state of health.

In my own long experience I could not help but remark the intimate relation between the effect of these great planets of our Universe and humanity in general. Although it would not be within the scope of this work to teach also Astrology in these pages, I must, however, in order to help all earnest students and readers of this book, put before them the following curious evidence of the influence of the planets on our lives. This is also demonstrated by the position and shape of the Mounts on the Hand, and, as far as I know, has never been published in any book dealing with Palmistry before.

My readers will now easily follow me when I state that, especially as regards health and disease, the following tables concerning the Mounts of the Hand, taken in conjunction with the date of birth, will enable them, when reading the hand, to tell many things with an accuracy that will be most convincing both to themselves and to their hearers.

The first if large is Positive, and it has more importance when the person is born between the dates of March 21st and April 21st, and ina minor way until April 28th, which portion of the year in the Zodiac is called the House of Mars (Positive).

The second is considered Negative, and it has more importance when the person is born between October 21st and November 21st, and in a minor way until November 28th, because in the Zodiac this portion of the year is denoted as the House of Mars (Negative).
We will now consider the difference of these two positions, how distinctly they affect the mind and temperament, and also their relation as to health and tendency towards disease.

In the first Mount of Mars, at the commencement of the Line of Life, and especially when the subject is born in the House of Mars (March 21st to April 21st, and in a minor way until the 28th), he possesses a strong martial nature which will make its tendencies manifest in all actions of the life, whether the man be a business man, a soldier, ora leader of men in any line whatever.

As a rule these people are good-natured and generous, but spasmodic and impulsive in all their actions. Their greatest fault lies in their impulsiveness and lack of self- control, and unless a good Line of Head be shown on the hands, they rush madly into all kinds of difficulties and dangers and often make a complete muddle of their opportunities and the magnificent powers of leadership

In health they are prone to fevers and blood diseases, especially in their early life. In youth they are also very liable to fits, epilepsy, severe headaches, often water on the brain, and suffer greatly with their teeth.

The second Mount of Mars, lying between the Heart and Head Line (Plate VI., Part II.), is more important when the subject is born between the dates of 21st October and the 21st November and until November 28th. In the Zodiac this period of the year is called the House of Mars Negative or Mental.
In character they are the complete opposite of the former type, all the Mars qualities being in the mind and in the mental attitude towards people and things.

They love to fight mentally, however, and in debates or arguments they also fight to the finish. They are more quietly determined than the former class of Mars subjects. They are even more obstinate in their views, but conceal their opinions, and often pass for assenting parties when in reality they are but waiting for the right opportunity to strike their mental blow and confuse their opponent.

Mars Negative people are generally so versatile and many- sided that they are the most difficult of all to place in some special career. If a good Line of Head be found on the hand, then there is nothing in the world of mental endeavour in which they will not make a success. It is a curious fact that these people seldom carry out what they were first trained for, and in fact in the course of their lives they are likely to change their profession or vocation as many times as the proverbial cat has lives.

Mars Negative people, especially when young, should above all things be carefully brought up with good companions. They should be especially warned to control their sex nature and be kept aloof from all perverse persons and evil books.

When large, it shows desire to dominate, to rule and command others, to lead and organise, and to carry out some distinct object. But these good qualities will only be employed if the Line of Head is clear and long. When this line is poor and badly formed, then a large Mount of Jupiter gives pride, excess of vanity, a self-confident and a self-opinionated person. But on what is known as a good well-marked hand, there is no Mount more excellent and no surer indication of success from sheer strength of character and purpose.

In Part II the author says that no question can be answered from a study of one or two lines. All the signs of the hand have to be studied. In the beginning of any course of training in the subject, the author tells his students that the Line of Life tells of the vital force of

a person, the Head Line about his mental capacity, the Heart Line about his emotions and sentiments and the Line of Saturn about his worldly goods or wealth. Once the students have grasped these fundamental principles they are told that the Line of Life does not indicate only the state of an individual's health, but also speaks of his wealth, family and travels. Similarly questions with regard to marriage cannot be answered with reference to the lines of sexuality (marriage lines) alone, but a study of many other lines is vital to them. Along thumb signifies intelligence and discretion in its owner, whereas the short thumb is an indication of tendency towards haste. Its first phalange (on which the nail grows) is a measure of a person's resolve. Those with a long first phalange are men/women of action

and the second phalange indicates the capacity for thought. Those with a longer second phalange have little inclination to action, but are always immersed in thought. Those with a short thumb are prone to act without thought.

The finger next to the thumb is called the Index finger. It represents the ego of a person and his desire for recognition or prestige. If the index finger is longer than normal it is indicative of a person's desire to dominate others; smaller than normal it represents a lack of ambition. Such a person is only a follower, never a leader.

The finger next to the Index finger is called the Middle finger. It represents the balance of mind, sagacity and the love of solitude. It is, in most cases, longer than the rest of the digits or fingers. If it is equal in length to the index or the third, or Ring finger, it is supposed to be a small middle finger. A person with such a finger will be petty- minded and those having a very long middle finger shy

The third or the Ring finger is indicative of a person's desire for ostentation and fame. A person with a small ring finger is totally devoid of the tendency towards ostentation. Nor do persons with such fingers take any risks. If the ring finger is longer than usual, ie., if it is longer than the index finger, a person would be given to too much ostentation and would love to take risks. Those risks include speculation, gambling and other games of chance.

The fourth or the Little finger represents eloquence and wit. A little finger which extends to the end of the first phalange of the third finger is considered to be of average length. If it is longer, these qualities become more pronounced in a person. Converse is the case if the finger is of less than average length. A person with a small little finger suffers from an inferiority complex and he does not have the courage to speak out his mind.

The mount at the base of the index finger indicates a person's desire to lead others, his ambitions and his ego. Palmists call it the Mount of Jupiter. That is why the finger has the peculiarities of Jupiter.

A palmist should study both the palms of all clients, whether men or women. If the lines on both the palms are similar, there are not many ups and downs in a person's life. If the lines are different, the palmist should study the hand which is more active. A hand which is used most often by a person to write with is called the more active hand. A majority of persons are right-handed. In a person who uses his left hand more often, the lines of the left hand should be studied first and than the other hand.

If the skin of the hand is flexible, a person is more likely to have a flexible character. But, if the skin is thick and hard, a person is not likely to change his views ina hurry. He is a person with firmness of character. If the skin is flexible and the hand is hard it is known as a Firm Hand. Such a person is given to thinking and also action. His views are both firm and flexible. If the skin is flexible and the hand soft, it is known as a Flabby Hand. Sucha person has an active mind, but less of physical strength or vitality.

Pink is an auspicious colour. People with a skin the colour of wheat have a similar tinge in their palms. That is also thought to be auspicious. A red palm indicates an angry disposition. If a palm is yellow in colour it is an indication of the possibility of the person falling a prey to jaundice. People with a white palm always think of their own interests.
People with a broad palm tend to look at the practical aspect of things. Physically they are more active. A person with a long palm is, usually, a planner by nature.

People with a small hand have a tendency to look at things in a superficial manner and are wont to overlook the details. They do everything in a hurry. Similar is the case with people with small fingers. The latter are also quick workers.
Conversely, people with a large hand do things in detail. The pace of their work is slow. If the fingers are long, the standard of their performance goes up, but the speed is reduced.

A heavy or a full hand indicates a man of action. Such a person would not easily admit defeat. He is apt to be frank. It is difficult to define what is going on in the mind of a person with thin hands.

The line or mount towards with a line of influence moves has more attraction in the life of that individual. These lines give rise to figures known as cross, star or island. But its effect is seen only when there is another parallel line a little away, or when the Line of the Sun originates. The line which is close to the Line of Saturn is called the Kuthar Rekha (axe line) which interferes with the success of efforts to gain the worldly goods.

It starts from the wrist, the line of life, the line of Saturn or the Mount of the Moon. It inclines towards the Mount of the Sun. This line indicates the success of one's efforts, whether in the acquisition of wealth, politics, a court case, travel or a love affair. A person gets his heart's desire at the time of its coming on the scene. We shall deal with estimating the time when we come to the part of the book where we recap what we have written in this part.

Samudrika Shastra calls it the Arogya or Swasthya Rekha. Western palmists call it the line of health or the Hepatica (concerned with the health of the liver). Palmists do not agree on its origin or its effect. But the experience of the present author is that this line indicates the sharpness of intelligence or his business sense. It originates from the Mount of Venus, or the Line of Life, the Line of Saturn or the Mount of the Moon and it terminates at the Mount of Mercury. A clear, well-defined line indicates intelligence and good health. A broken-up Line of Mercury is an indication of indifferent health and confused thinking.

Some palmists believe that it is a line of influence of the Mount of Venus. It is a parallel line within the Line of Life. If It is very near the line of life or if it is very deep it indicates the extent to which a person is subject to fits of anger. If it is away from the Line of Life the person is likely to be of an equable temper. It also indicates the state of marital relations. It originates from the Aggressive Mars, runs parallel to the Line of Life towards the Mount of Venus and terminates at the wrist or the Mount of Venus.

We have called the line popularly known as the Marriage Line as the Line of Sexuality, because it indicates relationships of an individual which are connected with sex. Such a relationship might continue without religious sanction for a long time. This line originates from the percussion (outer part of the palm) near the Mount of Mercury and is inclined towards it.

If the line is straight, it is generally indicative of a good marital relationship or an enduring love affair. If this line inclines towards the Heart Line it indicates an interruption with marital relations or ill health of the spouse. If this line inclines towards the little finger, the spouse is likely to have a long life. This line may not be a single one, but there might be two or even three such lines. Thin and deep lines are auspicious. A line not very deep, but broad is inauspicious. The strength of a shallow line is meagre. If you want to find out the difference between a shallow and a deep line, stretch it. If a line vanishes on stretching, it is shallow line, but that which remains visible under this condition is a deep line. It is good if a line of influence is shallow. If the main lines on

a palm are broad and very deep, their effect is ordinary. If a line is thick at one place and thin at another, fortune smiles on the person at the time of life when the line becomes thin. The stopping of the thick line is also an indication of good fortune.

When you are studying a palm and find that a line has stopped short of its destination, do not think that it is a sign of misfortune. First see whether the line is thin and deep at the place it has stopped or thick and deep. In the latter case all obstacles to a person's fortune disappear at the time the line has stopped. If the thin and deep line has stopped it is an indication of no new sources of income appearing, but greater income from the existing ones. Broken down lines and those intersected by the lines of influence are a sign of fluctuations in a man's fortunes, of what he is likely to gain or to lose.

It must be remembered that the only intersection of a main line by a line of influence is considered intersection. The main or secondary lines follow their paths and any intersection on the way cannot be considered to be a cross.

When aclient tells you that he is ambidextrous -- that is he is equally proficient in the use of both his hands, take his left hand to be the active hand. To know the reason why it should be so, look at the social milieu in which you live.

Our society looks down upon a person who uses his left hand and he is told repeatedly to use his right hand. Because of these importunings, the person who is used to the use of his left hand starts using his right too. But, he finds it easy to use the left, even if he works with both he hands. According to the principles of palmistry his left hand should be taken to be the active hand. The reason is that his basic instinct is to use his left hand.

My students often ask me: why is it that the same Line of Life tells you about the family, the wealth of the individual and also his vital force Similarly, the Line of Saturn gives an indication of marriage, wealth and many other aspects of human life. The lines of Heart, Head and Mars, in the same manner can be interpreted to mean different things. What bothers the students is how to interpret a line in what manner at what time.

The digits 0 to 9 are used to write figures which may be hundreds or billions. The seven notes in music can be employed to compose myriads of ragas and the dictionaries of the world use only 26 letters from A to Z. Similarly the limited number of lines on the palm are interpreted in various ways to read the destiny of human beings.

In so far as the question as to which line mean what in each hand is concerned, it can be answered only in relation to the query of your client and the context in which that is made. Words in any language mean

different things according to context. Right means the one opposed to left, correct and a legally and morally just claim. Get means to obtain, but in conjunction with other words its meaning might change, i.e. in get away, get back, get down, get in, get off, get on, get out, get over, get through, get together and get up etc. Such examples can be multiplied. If, then, each line on the palm has a different meaning according to the context in which it is interpreted, one should not wonder. The lines of the palm have a language of their own and like every other language it has its own grammar and its own rules. - AUTHOR

to distinguish between an astrologer and a palmist an d between a palmist and a tantrik. An astrologer consults a horoscope to give his reading of his client's future; a palmist does the same through a reading of the signs on the palm, but the field of a tantrik is entirely different. Because of the confusion in the mind of the common man about the roles of these three, the palmist finds it difficult to work in a scientific manner. We would, however, try to get round this difficulty and would indicate the method of interpreting the lines of the palm to answer questions which bother a palmist's client.

Let us take an example from medicine. If a person suffers from diabetes, his eyes and his heart are likely to be affected by that condition. If the liver is malfunctioning, a patient's appetite, thirst and his weight are likely to be affected. This is because the various systems of the body are inter-related; each affects the other. Similar is the case with the lines of the palm. If one of the lines is defective, it is likely to affect the others too adversely. That is why all the lines of the palm have to be studied to give a proper reading. The difficulty arises in finding the chief cause of the defect.

Sometimes when a client is told of certain events in his past he refuses to admit that they ever happened. What I do in such cases is to close his fist and tell him that Ihave been unable to understand the sign on his palm. In nine out of ten cases, the client spreads his palm and admits that he was only pretending that my reading was wrong and importunes me to give him a reading.

These arts were commonly known as various systems for telling the future. This is the way these arts were advertised by most of their practitioners, and the common man looks at them with a mix of doubt and belief as they give an oil paper view to their past and future events. Among these systems hand reading being the most convenient, developed most. Thats why we see that palmistry is practiced extensively in all parts of the world. Interestingly, all of these branches of the ancient system of Samudrik Shastra point to the same thing about a person. So a person who goes to a hand reader, or to a forehead reader or to a face reader will get a similar interpretation.

Here we are talking about palmistry only. Now as far as real palm reading is concerned it has little to do with future telling. The basic aim of palmistry has never been fortune telling; the real aim is much bigger. Suppose for a moment that a palmist predicts the future of a person, and tells him that he is going to have a bad marriage ahead and that his wife may ask for divorce in the next few years. Now, how is this information going to help this person and what positive effect has it brought to this person One could argue that since this person is aware of his future he may take care in his life. But if it really is the future then this is of little help since these interpretations are made with such a conviction that this person may

think, I'd better not get married. Or even if he marries, in the back of his mind he will be thinking that soon hell be divorced. He'll say to his wife whenever they fight, I know that our marriage is going to end soon, and that palmist told me because of you it will happen.
In the past, as we all know, when a child was born his horoscope was made and his hand was shown to wise people.

can be told from the hand and if a palmist says that he will be an artist or musician in life, he is not predicting the future but is merely telling the potentials of this guy. This is actually the real goal of palmistry: to recognize the hidden potentials of an individual and help him to bring them out. Its not only good for this person but it is also very beneficial for society that its members make good progress.

So the hand reader simply tries to read the combined effect of many personality factors on his life and all this he interprets in the words was and will. This is what people call predictions. I tell you a secret of my profession; if I read the character of a person accurately from his hand, then most of the other things I see about his past and future also seem very accurate for they are connected.

This actually explains why hands can accurately tell about past events. Our subconscious brain is a big computer that never forgets anything, so the events that were really important to us and made some influence are also recorded and become part of its calculations. These things can be seen in hands. But none can say what events will be considered important and be recorded. For example, if a person gets his first job and this person considers it to be a very important moment, then it will be marked in his hand, otherwise not.

Here it is note-worthy (it is my own finding) that whatever the hand lines show is not what actually happened, rather they reveal what influences it made upon you and how you felt at that moment. So if there is a good event at a moment in life then it tells that at that moment something made you feel happy, thats why it was good. In the same way, a bad event in hand lines does not necessarily mean that something bad happened or may happen, rather it is a sign telling that this person felt bad at that time. Maybe if you ask his close friends,

they may say No that was a very good time for him. But what was perceived as good by others made him uneasy, so in his subconscious calculations, it was bad. Take an example of a man divorced from his wife, this can be a really disastrous moment for his wife, and her hand lines may reveal the same. But this person's hand lines may show quite the opposite, it may be a very good moment for him since he felt really relieved. Of course later he may say that it was difficult for him and so on. So these lines may be misleading at times (in terms of reality) because they show things as one has seen them. But this is the real beauty of this formidable art; it allows a palmist to look at life from the view point of the subject. In psychology this is called empathy and a lot of stress is given on that. Believe me; palmistry gives the real empathetic view.

In ancient India (even now in many cases) people were of the view that for the man the right hand should be seen, and for women the left hand should be seen. Later, people started to say that if a man or woman is independent for his earnings and decisions then his right hand should be seen, but if anyone is dependent on their parents or husband then their left hand should be studied. Now most of the palmists are of the view that the active hand should be seen and there should be no discrimination of age or sex. But in modern times generally both hands are

The passive hand tells the past habits and incidents of life. These past habits and behaviours were the results of his environmental and genetic influences (from parents). The active hand tells about the present and future. The active hand tells the present behaviour of the person and what changes this person has brought into his life. So it can be easily understood that if a person has different lines in both of his hands, then he has brought many changes into his life. If he has better lines and signs in his active hand, then he is making positive changes. However, if his passive hand has better lines then it clearly means that he had better potential and had good chances, but he could not make use of them.

The shape of a hand or palm is an important aspect as it tells how carefully a person does anything. Here we measure the length of palm from the first bracelet line to the base of the middle finger. Width is taken horizontally from one side to the other. A 20% difference is natural between the length and breadth of the hand. For example if the length of the palm is 10cm and the width is 8cm, we will call it normal. However, if the length is 11cm and the width is 8cm, the difference will be of 30% and the hand will be narrow. A wide hand is one with 10cm length and 9cm width. Now we will discuss them separately.

Also called the long hand. Narrow hand means quality and fineness. People with narrow hands work on small details. They focus only on the small parts of task and only after doing it well, they look further. They love details and fineness. They can keep working on a single task without any care for time. What they are concerned with is how perfection can be brought to their work. They love their work to be appreciated as they always put their heart into it, to make it the best every single time. Artists playing musical instruments, singers, painters and anyone doing fine work such as designing, jewellery making or any such task have long hands. Moreover, people with narrow hands are better at performing mental tasks rather than physical tasks. But narrow hands alone do not promise to make someone an artist or musician, but a perfectionist in any job.
A palm with a good proportion between length and width i.e. length 20% more than breadth of palm will be called normal and it points to a good balance between quality and speed.

The size of the fingers is decided by the size of the middle finger. Here, the middle finger can be accepted as representative of all the fingers. The palm is the area from bracelets to the root of the middle finger. The normal length of the fingers is 20% less than the length of the palm. So again, the correct ratio is 8:10. For example, if the middle finger is 8cm long and the palm is 10cm long then its normal. In that case, a middle finger of less than 8cm length (if the palm is 10cm long) would be called short (7:10), and greater than 8cm length would be called long (9:10). The length of the fingers tells the depth of thinking and how much concentration one is putting into his tasks.

the mountain of Venus and limiting its area. This line helps us to understand the major events of life, family relationships, mental peace, health and up to a great extent the economical standard of a person's life. Always remember that any line wherever it starts or wherever it finishes takes the qualities of that particular mountain. A line also means efforts and results of those efforts.

A Life line starting close to Jupiter takes the ambitions, pride, self respect, ideals and leadership from this mountain. These qualities show in character and more importantly it is a line so it tells efforts and results. Such a person makes efforts to fulfil ambitions and to rise to a

position of self respect and leadership. If other lines are also good then we can expect that these efforts will give good results. Moreover it tells a calm and serious nature. As you can see, this is away from Mars so these people try in the best possible way to refrain from all sorts of quarrel.

A Life line starting close to Mars Attacking takes its aggressive quality. It makes a person very offensive and hot tempered, so these people get irritated very easily and by very small things. These people often find themselves in quarrels and fights.

If it goes towards the Moon it takes a restless and imaginative nature from the Moon. In such a case the person has a strong desire to make changes and this is the reason of his restlessness. Since this is a line it indicates

some efforts. So that person makes an effort to make a big change and the result is that he settles in a new place or country away from his native place (it is to be noted that its not really important whether this line reaches the mountain or not, it's enough if this line looks to be going in a particular direction). In most hands, the Life line ends at the wrist (between the Moon and Venus). It is the normal condition of the line. In this case it means nothing special.

(Any line when deep, thin and strong gives good results.) A thin, deep and round Life line tells good family life, good health, vital power and will power. The part of the Life line where it is good means that the person will enjoy good family life, good health and will power in this time of life.

The part of the life line which is chained, thick or wavy tells a period in which a man may suffer due to poor health. Other problems at the same time can be some personal or family problems resulting in loss of mental peace and sometimes health problems. A better line after a waved or broken line tells recovery in health. Sometimes the line becomes red or it loses its strength and looks quite weak, then it also means health problems or other family issues. It should be noted that the most of the difficulties in human life are mental tensions that can arise from a small incident. It is really amazing how in this world, one thing can affect various people in many different ways. But any bad patch of the Life line tells a situation where a person may feel that he is facing a problem.

Sometimes we see that the whole line looks thick and chained. One may wonder if these people will spend all their life in a hospital or if their life will be full of struggle and difficulties. But if you ask them they may not agree with this. They will say that they are having a perfectly normal and happy life (then it sounds that this entire palmistry thing is rubbish). Actually, these people are very sensitive and delicate and they take everything to heart too deeply. So they are always worried and troubled by something. Every day they have some problem giving them reason to be tense. Yet these problems are never big enough to be remembered after a few weeks or months. (For example a person can be worried about what will happen if he does not finish his project in time. He may

fear that his boss is not happy and may fire him. At the same time he is worried about his children who do not listen to him and about their school teachers who complain regarding their performance. His wife is also ill so he needs to cook while he is all too busy to do his household chores and to care for his wife. In the office he also has trouble with one of his colleagues. And so on... there can be thousands of problems that give troubles but none too big in themselves). Besides that, they have a delicate health that keeps on giving some small health troubles regularly. But they may or may not have anything serious to report.

Indian palmistry it was said to be the mark of certain death, but today we know that this can also be some other major trouble in life. If the Life line is broken in both hands then there is a big chance that it is death, if broken in one hand only then most probably it is not death. It can certainly bring some accident or serious trouble (health, family, emotional) but not death.

If another part of the Life line is covering this gap then it becomes a change and not a break. The transition period can be difficult but not as difficult as a break. This person feels that this was a big change in life and for some time he felt he was losing control of life.

(Lines coming out as a branch of any line are always good. They tell some special effort at that point. To whichever mountain these lines go they mean success in that particular field.) Lines coming out as a branch of the Life line and going above towards the fingers, tell the success in the field of that particular mountain.

For example a branch going towards Jupiter tells the efforts to reach a position of self respect and where a person may feel his ambitions fulfilled. Lines mean not only efforts but also results. So these lines also mean the positive result of these efforts. If some branch goes to Saturn (Saturn denotes luck) then it becomes an extra luck line and tells an extra income source or sometimes a deep interest or hobby (from which one may choose not to earn). In the same way, a branch going towards the Sun (Sun is all material pleasures, fame and satisfaction) tells fame and satisfaction from material things. A branch going towards Mercury tells success in the field of communication and business matters. If a branch goes to the Moon then it takes a person away from his native

place. Many people describe these lines as travel lines, (Moon is the area of restlessness and desire of change) but Ive seen that a branch going towards the Moon tells that these people spend a long part of their lives away from their native place. More often than not they will settle in a new city or country. Its to be noted that these things do not necessarily happen only at the time when these branches come out of the Life line. Still these moments definitely are important as one can ask why this branch came out at that moment particularly. Now one more important thing is that these lines don't have to reach the mountains necessarily, it's their direction that is important. If there is a big and strong branch it reasonably implies strong efforts and strong results while small and faint lines will tell results accordingly.

Branches inside the Life line going towards Venus are not good as they are downward lines. They tell some loss of life force. Whenever any such line comes out of the Life line, it brings some accident or surgery. But otherwise, lines parallel to the Life line are always good and they tell support of the people who love this individual. Now it is to be noted that these support lines shouldn't touch the life line at any point otherwise as a result they can give a health problem or surgery.

Lines crossing the Life line are not good; they always tell problems. They cause some family problem that can be emotional (a break-up or dispute with a family member) or sometimes even serious ones such as the death of a family member. Big and strong lines tell serious troubles while small and weak lines tell small family problems. Sometimes, if such a line cutting the Life line is very strong and long, then this can also tell divorce or death in the family. If the same line cuts the luck line and the Head line too, then it brings a loss of money and harms professional progress and mental tension too. Here, family can include your friends and all those people who have some effect on your life. Sometimes it can also include our employer or employees.

If the Life line is crossed by many small horizontal lines they indicate oversensitivity and this person is continuously troubled by small things. These people have a tendency to get upset easily. They react a lot to petty things in life. (It should be understood in the same way as discussed above about a continuously thick and chained Life line. These people should be advised to look at things more easily and be more patient).

A star or cross on the life line tells about an operation or accident at that age. It should be noted that stars are good only on mountains but on lines they are very bad. An island somewhere on the Life line tells a very difficult time for that period of the Life line. This difficulty can be related to health or family problems. Triangles and squares are always good signs everywhere in the hand. Triangles and squares on the Life line indicate a good period in which most people invest their money in permanent things such as land or property. Or it could also be a time of learning too, or a time when one has a good time in life.

If the Life line ends mid way then it means lack of vital power from that moment. (It is like a warranty period on machinery, once it has expired the machine may keep on running for months and years after that, but any major defect can make it permanently damaged). If it is short in one hand only, then most probably it is a health problem or a difficult family life. Mostly the line of Mars runs parallel to the Life line and compensates its shortage up to a certain extent. One important thing to note is that the Life line (or any other line) does not tell the length of life or longevity, rather the Life line tells the quality of life. The end of the Life line at any point would mean that the strength (family, health or will power) associated with life will be missing. Now, one might wonder why sometimes

in one hand the Life line disappears, starts fading or gets disturbed in any way at the end, yet in the other hand it is stronger and better than the first one for its whole length. If the Life line fades or disappears at the end in the active hand, while it is good in the passive hand for the whole length, then it logically points out that this person is losing his life force due to a bad life style (in a number of cases alcohol and drugs play this part). Still, if the Life line is short in both hands and there is no Mars line behind it, then it can mean a short life after the point where the Life line stops for some people.
Often the Life line itself is short but a line of Saturn (Luck line) or any other supporting line goes onto the Life line's path then it tells a special and big change in the life of that
person. After this change, this persons way of thinking and his life altogether changes dramatically. The time of transition can be difficult but for sure it's not a break. Here

The moment when the Life line touches the Mercury line is considered a fatal moment in life. When the Life line touches or crosses the Health line then this moment may prove to be dangerous. It brings serious accident or illness or sometimes even death. Sometimes this moment is physically traumatic and sometimes emotionally. Inmy

If the start of the Life line is disturbed, Ive seen that most of the times it also means that the relation of this person with his mother were not very sweet or this person, somehow, missed the love of his mother.
Of course it can also mean other troubles (like health) in early age.
But if in such a case a luck line also starts with a fork and island then this definitely means that this person missed the love of his mother.
I also want to tell that if the Life line is bad at its start then it can also be some other trouble and not just some trouble with the mother.)

Finally, one should understand that the Life line tells the quality of life and not the quantity (i.e. longevity). A long life line doesnt mean necessarily a long life and short life line, a short life. We can put age marks on the Life line as described in later part of this manual.

A fork or trident at the end of any line is good. A fork at the end of the Head line increases the mental capacity, this provides interest in literature. Besides this, if one branch of the fork leans towards Mercury and the other towards the Moon, then the person uses his imagination in his business and is successful. At the end, if the Head line is divided into 3 branches going towards Mercury, Mars and the Moon then this combination gives extra mental power. If the Head line remains straight at the start and then with a sharp turn goes towards the Moon then logically we can understand that in the later part of life that man becomes interested in fine arts. If the finger joints are obvious then due to analytical ability this man becomes interested in philosophy. Leaning in a continuous manner means that the imagination develops with the age naturally.

A chained, broad or weak line gives poor concentration, nervousness and no mental peace. These people are very prone to some mental disorder. But it does not mean that everyone having this line will be put into a mental hospital. But it definitely tells a warning signal that these people are putting a lot of stress onto their minds.

The presence of two Head lines instead of one, whether right from the start or due to an early split of the Head line (creating a second line running parallel to it), means that the person has a many faced personality. It gives that person extra mental capacities and a great deal of intelligence. But it comes with some confusion about ones own desires and purpose of life. An all-rounder but confused about which way to go. They wonder what they want from their life. These people have a contradiction in their personality. They are very unpredictable. Different people look at them with different views because they have seen such different things in their character.

An island in any line is bad. An island on the Head line below Jupiter tells mostly poor relationship with the father. An island below Saturn gives regular headaches or migraines (Saturn means deep thinking so an island below Saturn tells too much thinking and stress on the head). I proved it in my research and this research is published in a reputed psychology journal too. For better learning check the hands of a few people whom you know to be suffering from these troubles. An Island below the Sun causes poor eye sight (wearing glasses; check it in

An island below Mercury gives mental problems in later life (like forgetting or speaking irrelevant things when getting older). Triangles and squares on this line mean this person is blessed with good intellectual capacity, and he can earn some good money and material pleasures because of his
intellectual capacities. Upside or down it is same. Cross, star and dot on the Head line mean serious head injury.

A change in the Head line means a big change in the way of thinking that could be the result of some traumatic incident most probably in the past. A broken Head line means a serious head injury in accident that can prove dangerous to life.

A long Head line means a developed mind that can think in all directions of life. While a short Head line means rather limited capacities of the brain. Such a person can be good at one or two things in life (and be superb there) but at others he is less than average. For example, this person can be a great professor of physics and his students may wonder how the professor knows everything about physics but this professor's wife knows that in reality, the professor knows nothing beyond physics. The reason is simple that this person has confined himself to very few things.

Lines crossing the Head line (except luck line, Sun line and Mercury line) tell tensions and problems causing mental discomfort and loss of mental peace. Crossing of luck line, Sun line or Mercury line mean nothing as this is the natural path of these lines to go towards the finger, and any line in its normal position doesn't show any trouble.

Branches of the Head line going to whichever mountain, give efforts and success in that particular direction. A branch towards Jupiter tells efforts to fulfilling ambitions and achieving a position of pride because of the mental capacity of the individual. Branches to Saturn will tell an extra income source, branches to the Sun tell getting fame and all material pleasures. Branches to Jupiter mean ambitions fulfilled and a position of pride. In the same
way, branches to Mars Attacking bring frustrations and aggression in the character.

If the Heart line starts at the mountain of Jupiter then it takes the ideal approach and dominance of Jupiter in emotional relationships. These people give importance to emotional love and mental pleasure (with their girlfriend or boyfriend they dont have sexual demands alone; in other emotional relations they dont have many material expectations). Their love is seen as very stable. They are quite romantic lovers. But because of the dominance of Jupiter some possessive nature comes in love. These people become over-protective and jealous. They ask too many questions (like 'where were you, Whom were you talking to, Why did you come late). Sometimes they do emotional blackmailing. Thats why their loved one feels that they are being controlled. They also expect

their loved one to be an ideal being coming from heaven (because of the idealistic nature of Jupiter). But they have no material expectations in love, and are very dedicated lovers (women have this kind of line).

A Heart line starting outside Jupiter (from outside the palm and running straight to the other way outside Mercury) tells that these people love their dear ones like mad. They become obsessive lovers who love a great deal but want to keep their loved one only in front of them. Their over protection, excessive care and the many questions they ask is their way of showing love. These persons mostly fail in love. It is to be noted that love should be taken in its wider sense (i.e. not only for boyfriend and girlfriend but also for other people).

Such a person starts thinking about profit and loss in love. This is the reason that it is more of a selfish type of love (thinking and planning are qualities of the Saturn). From their boyfriend or girlfriend they have high sexual demands and from others it might be material demands. These people invest their love where it is profitable. They make emotional relationships and friendships with those people who they think can be beneficial in future. They tend to remember what good they did to others but the opposite is not very true. This also is the reason why many times they feel that nobody loves them. But still, we cant say that they dont love their people; they do love but they
also have some demands. If this line moves up towards the base of the middle finger it increases this tendency.

If the Heart line starts from the middle of Saturn and Jupiter, then this person thinks in a practical way. Their love has both ideals and self. They are neither too dedicated nor blind lovers, nor have a lot of demands. Its a practical and generous (men have this kind of line) kind of emotional relationship.

The branches of the Heart line are always good. They tell a big, generous heart and joyful nature. These people remain happy and try to make others happy too. Besides, whichever mountain these branches go to, they take the qualities of that place. For example if a branch goes to Jupiter, it makes a very committed lover while if it goes to Saturn then it makes a person demanding in relations.

Abroad or chained line tells a nature of flirt. These people are broken heart and become attached with anyone very easily but later feel that they are not attached to this person anymore. These people also complain that they did so much for other people but none came to help them in time of need. These people like to flirt and get impressed by people of the opposite sex easily.

A Heart line with an island also tells emotional trouble or a failure in love. But if this island is below the mountain of the Sun then this also tells weak eyesight along with emotional troubles. If a branch of the Heart line goes towards the Sun, then this person has certain standards for his or her partner. Here strong lines crossing the Heart line tell worries of health related with heart problems and blood pressure too.

If the Heart line is thin and deep but has no branches and runs straight then the person becomes cold lacking the warmth in his behaviour. Branches of the Heart line makes a person warm. But if you want to know the time of this it is impossible to calculate when hell wear the glasses. So I always teach that the Heart line tells the quality of relationships and emotional character of the person, irrespective of time.

The Luck line is the line that goes towards Saturn. Actually any line that looks to be going towards Saturn can be called the Luck line. Now this line can start anywhere and finish anywhere (it is not really necessary that this line should reach the mountain of Saturn). Moreover there can be more than one Luck line too.

This line, in my experience, does not tell luck or destiny as its name may suggest. This line tells the efforts of a person to make his life better. So this line tells about the progress of the person in terms of money, business, property, career and relations. It can start from:

For a long time whatever this person does is only for the benefit of the family alone. Their individual progress comes only when the luck line cuts the life line and goes up. This time also brings some fighting with the family since at this moment he wants to do something that his people dont like. This is a fight for independence.

If the Saturn line (or Luck line) starts as a branch of the Life line then this person is not independent enough to choose his path. Since this Luck line starts late (independently), so logically these people also start thinking seriously about their life from a late age as compared to those whose luck line starts separately from the life line. His independent identity becomes possible when the Luck line gets separated from the Life line. If the Luck line starts from the wrist but without touching (the main branch of) the Life line, it tells an independent person who has his own decision about his profession. A Luck line starting from the Moon tells a desire for social attention. They also care a lot about their looks i.e. if they are looking smart. They spend a lot of time in front of the mirror. Basically they can be good at professions where success depends upon the likes and dislikes of other people. These people can be artists, actors, politicians or anyone who is in public dealing. Besides it, this line may start from the mid part of the palm or from the Heart line or from the Head line too. It doesnt mean that they weren't doing anything for this many years, rather it means that their efforts were not serious enough even in their own eyes. As discussed earlier, it is not really a luck or fortune line so it should be noted that it is not a line of Luck alone that makes someone rich or poor. Social and economical factors play an important role too.
A thick, chained or red line means a time of struggle. But when this thick line changes into a thin and clear line, this is the time when this person will reap the fruits of success.

On the contrary, if the Luck line turns thick at some point, this indicates the beginning of a tough period of life. Here, an island is much worse than a thick line or a red line. The time of this event can be calculated by the age system of the Luck line.

If a line runs parallel to the Luck line for a little distance (on the left or the right side of the luck line) then it becomes a support line to the Luck line. person's boyfriend or girl friend. Sometimes this relation can also turn into marriage. If with that line, the Luck line becomes more intense then it brings happiness, if the Luck line faints or becomes thick then it brings mental tension. If this line running parallel is crossed by some other small line then this can be the time when this relationship comes to an end.

Sometimes if this support line is strong and long enough, this parallel line becomes a second Luck line and it means a part time income or second income source. The shape of the hand is an indication of the basic nature of the person concerned. Basic human instincts are: hunger, thirst, sex drive, anger, fear, etc. Instincts are basic to a mans nature and he is born with them. No process of learning is involved in them. Chirognomy is the name of the science which helps one to find the instincts of the owner of the hand.
The lines of the palm indicate the past, the present and the future of man. The science which deals with them is known as chiromancy.
The palm is a mirror of our brain and mind. There are raised mounds of flesh on the palm which are known as mounts in palmistry. They indicate the activity of the various centres of our brain.

The lines on the palm are the waves which indicate what goes on in our subconscious mind which has been compared to an iceberg. An iceberg, as you know, is 9/10 submerged in water and only the top 1/10 of it is visible.

The desires which lie dormant in our subconscious mind are the building blocks of the future. These desires show themselves as lines on our palms. When we read the lines of the palm, we are, in fact, trying to read the subconscious, because only a reading of the subconscious leads us to read the future.

The lines on the palms are graphs of the mind, just like the ECG which represents graphically the movements of the heart. Just as you have to be a cardiologist to interpret the wavy lines of the ECG, similarly you have to know the science of palmistry to interpret the significance of the lines on the hand.

If the imprint of the hand taken a long time ago is compared with the one taken recently, you would notice the changes  some lines may have vanished and others taken their place. The palmist should motivate his client to change his hand lines so that the inauspicious can be changed into auspicious.

By reading the lines of the palm we are reading the subconscious mind which, in turn, means trying to gauge the possibilities inherent in man. Reading the possibilities is akin to reading a mans destiny.
A learner of palmistry is faced with the question as to which hand of the client should be studied before a prediction is made  the right or the left
According to ancient treatise on Hindu palmistry, Samudrika Shastra, a woman's left hand and a mans right hand should be read for making predictions.

The author's view is that the left hand indicates the innate qualities of a man while the right reveal the changes brought about by the owner of the hand through his own actions. That is why both the hands must be studied, but more emphasis should be on the right hand (the active hand). This holds good in the case of women too.
An active hand is that with which a person writes; the other hand should be considered of minor importance.

Most people work with their right hand and if the lines on the left palm are favourable and those on the right unsatisfactory, you can take it that your client has more inborn qualities but has destroyed his destiny with his own actions. If the lines on the left hand are infavourable and those on the right acceptable, it means that the person has improved his prospects in life because of his ability and talent.

To sum up, both the hands should be studied. Signs which are similar on both hands can lead you to reach definite conclusions. But, where the signs are not similar, the deciding factor would be the signs on the main hand (the active hand).

Very rare are the cases where the signs on both the hands are similar. If you find such a person, you can be sure that there will not be many ups and downs in his life. If the signs are different, they signify many ups and downs in the life of such a person. Whether those changes are good or bad, you will learn on studying the book further and as you acquire practice in palm reading.

Very few hands have phalanges of equal width. There are differences in the length and breadth of the phalanges. It is this difference which indicates the hidden feelings of the owner of the hand as also his disposition. But, we will come to this aspect when we discuss the fingers in detail.
Palmistry divides the palm into nine zones. Each zone indicates a mental or physical peculiarity of the individual. The zones are also known as mounts (see Fig. 4-
the appropriate place, but here we shall indicate their positions on the palm and some of their peculiarities to help you understand their role and also what comes In the following chapters.

The basal zone below the first or index finger indicates a persons desire for leadership, his ambition and his ego. It is called the Mount of Jupiter. The index finger at the base of which this mount is situated thus carries qualities of the planet Jupiter.

The zone at the base of the second or middle finger indicates whether a person is of sober temperament or not, whether he has the power of analysis and loves solitude or company. This mount has been named as the Mount of Saturn. The middle finger indicates the qualities of this planet.

The zone at the base of the third or ring finger indicates a persons zest for life, his tendency to show off and his desire for recognition. This mount is named as the Mount of Apoillo or Sun. The ring finger has some of the qualities associated with this mount.
The basal zone of the little or the fourth finger is an indication of a person's pragmatic nature and quick-
wittedness. It is called the Mount of Mercury. The little finger represents the quality of planet Mercury.

A small lower portion on the Mount of Mercury indicates the power of resistance of a person. The lower portion of the Mount of Jupiter indicates a person's courageous spirit and aggressive nature. In astrology, however, these two qualities are associated with the planet Mars.

Bravery is also a form of aggression which manifests itself in the form of initiative a person shows in a battle. That is why we have named the Lower Mars, a little below the Mount of Jupiter, as Aggressive Mars.

The zone under the Aggressive Mars, extending from the base of the thumb to the wrist, indicates the spirit of love, the vital force, sex and the degree of sympathy a person has. This is named as the Mount of Venus.
The zone lying amidst these mounts is generally depressed. It might be levelled in some palms to indicate the bodily strength of the person. It is known as the Plain of Mars.

The second type of hand is the square hand (see Fig. 5- B). The palm of such a hand and the fingertips are square. People with a square hand are pragmatic by nature but show less of imagination. They are the ones who respect

The seventh type of hand is the mixed hand (see Fig. 5-G). This hand possesses the characteristics of all other types of hands; hence the nomenclature Mixed Hand. The fingers are not uniformly shaped; one may be conical and another square. Still another might be pointed. Such a person has versatility of character.

If the hand is flexible, the person concerned, would show flexibility in his views and character. You can recognise a flexible hand by the fine pattern of capillaries on the palm which cannot be clearly seen without a magnifying glass. A person with a flexible hand has greater mental capacity than others. He is neither conservative not fixed in his views, but is always ready to accept new ideas.

If the skin of the palm is flexible, but the palm itself is firm, the hand is called a firm hand. A person with a firm hand has both the power of thought as well as action. People with a firm hand think things out and take action to their logical conclusion.

An average hand indicates the speed of work of a person and it would be average. Also average would be the standard of his work. If the fingers of such a hand are short, the speed with which the man completes his work would increase but the thought that goes into its completion decreases. Knotty fingers indicate an attentive and observant person who is curious to know everything around him. Such a person has the capacity to think, analyse and argue things to their logical conclusion. But he is not fast to act.

Each finger, as we have already stated, has three phalanges. The phalanges are not of uniform length or thickness. The first phalange indicates the emotional state of a person. If it is longer, the person is likely to be sentimental and a bit of an idealist.

The first or index finger represents the ego of a person and is an indication of his qualities of leadership (see Fig. 7-A). A peculiarity of this finger is that it can be extended alone without the other fingers of the hand moving one bit.

At the base of the index finger is the Mount of Jupiter. It represents the characteristics of Jupiter. If it is a little shorter than the middle finger and almost equal in length to the third finger, it can be said to be of normal length. The normal length of the index finger means that its possessor expects respect from others.
If the index finger is shorter than normal, the person tends to shy away from responsibility. He is a follower rather than a leader and his life is without any ambition.

If the index finger is equal in length to the ring or third finger, it tends to bring fame and honour to the person. If it is longer than the ring finger, it tends to increase the desire in the person for complete domination over others. If it is shorter than the ring finger, the person suffers from an inferiority complex.
If a long index finger is a little twisted, the person is desirous of flattery and if, in addition to being twisted, the finger is short, it is indicative of a mean disposition.

If the first phalange of the index finger is long, the qualities of leadership are heightened. He or she would be a leader, be it at home, in politics, in religion or in any other sphere. If the first phalange is short, the person hides himself, is shy to come forward and suffers from an inferiority complex.

If the tip of the index finger is rounded, it indicates that the person would engage in a noble vocation like that of a teacher. If the tip is square, the person would like to become a judge or a lawyer so that he can satisfy not only his ego, but also earn a considerable amount of money. Persons with spatulate-tipped index finger are talkative and love to boast.

If the setting of the index finger is even, its qualities are balanced. If the setting is low, it should be treated like a short index finger; if its high, it has the same qualities as a long one. If the first phalange of the little finger is long, the person is proficient in expressing himself through art, but to have the gift of the gab, the little finger has to have a high setting. If the fingers are inclined towards each other, it means that the finger which is inclined to another, passes on its energy to it.

If the little finger is inclined outwards, away from the third finger, the person leads a careless life in which he does not bother about what he should do and the way in which it should be done.

If the gap between the ring finger and the little finger is more than normal, the person does not accept any ties. He has a strong will power and does exactly as he wishes. If the gap is narrow, the opposite is the case.

Trace elements (minerals) in the body also influence the shape and size of the nails. If all the elements, including the hormones, are in a state of balance in the body, it takes about five months for the nail to grow. The time may be shorter or longer, depending on the age or the amount of hormones present in the body.

An ideal nail is one which is pinkish in colour, has a healthy shine, is sufficiently long as well as broad, and bulges outward, slightly like a TV screen. Such a nail indicates good mental as well as physical health.
Pinkish nails indicate a fine state of health and a liberal disposition.
A yellow nail indicates disorders of the liver, usually jaundice.
